etymology.historical_story: The spelling kaali illustrates why a written form alone cannot establish a word's history. A Bidayuh Serian dictionary records this spelling in connection with counting and multiplication, but the packet supplies no sentence identifying that language. Its proposed root kaal remains unverified. Assigning a Malay suffix, pronunciation, or borrowing history would therefore turn an unresolved form into an invented etymology.
